❓ Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ) — Sabre GDS & IATA Training

Essential answers for travel agency trainees and airline ticketing executives

1. What is the mandatory sequence to issue an E-Ticket on Sabre?

First create and save the PNR with 5 mandatory elements (1AVAIL, 01Y1, -NAME, 9PHONE, 7TAW/, 6A, ER). Next add 3DOCS, 3CTCM, and 3CTCE, store fare (WP & PQ), then run W¥PQ1N1.1¥ABG¥FINVAGT¥KP7¥ETR¥ER.

2. What do TE, TV, and TR mean in the *T ticket field?

In Sabre's *T field, TE means an active Electronic Ticket issued, TV means the ticket has been Voided same-day (WV2), and TR means the ticket has been Refunded (WFRF).

3. What are IATA Traffic Conference Areas (TC1, TC2, TC3)?

IATA divides the world into 3 areas for tariff construction: TC1 (North, Central, South America & Caribbean), TC2 (Europe, Middle East & Africa), and TC3 (Asia, South Asian Subcontinent & Southwest Pacific).

4. Which keyboard shortcuts work inside the Sabre Terminal?

Type I or press Alt+Backspace to completely clear the terminal display, type MD / MU to scroll down or up, and press Ctrl+R to refresh.

IATA World Traffic Conference Areas (TC1, TC2 & TC3 Master Map)

Official IATA geographical division of the world into Western Hemisphere (Area 1) and Eastern Hemisphere (Areas 2 & 3)

ALL 3 AREAS
TC1 — Traffic Conference Area 1 (Western Hemisphere)
  • North America: USA (incl. Alaska & Hawaii), Canada, Mexico, Greenland (GOH).
  • Central America: Guatemala, Belize, El Salvador, Honduras, Nicaragua, Costa Rica.
  • Caribbean Islands: Bahamas, Bermuda, Cuba, Jamaica, Haiti, Dominican Rep., Trinidad, Aruba.
  • South America: Brazil, Argentina, Chile, Colombia, Peru, Venezuela, Panama, Ecuador, Bolivia, Paraguay, Uruguay.
TC2 — Traffic Conference Area 2 (Europe, Middle East, Africa)
  • Europe: All EU/UK/Schengen states, Switzerland, Norway, Iceland, Turkey (IST/ANK), Russia West of Urals (MOW/LED), Ukraine, Caucasus (GE, AZ, AM), plus Morocco, Algeria, Tunisia.
  • Middle East: Saudi Arabia (JED/RUH), UAE (DXB/AUH), Qatar (DOH), Kuwait, Bahrain, Oman, Jordan, Lebanon, Iraq, Iran, Egypt (CAI), Sudan.
  • Africa: Central, Eastern, Southern, Western Africa & Indian Ocean Islands (Mauritius, Seychelles).
TC3 — Traffic Conference Area 3 (Asia & Oceania)
  • South Asian Subcontinent (SASC): Bangladesh (DAC/CGP/ZYL), India (DEL/BOM/CCU), Pakistan, Sri Lanka, Nepal, Maldives, Bhutan, Afghanistan.
  • South East Asia (SEA): Singapore (SIN), Thailand (BKK), Malaysia (KUL), Indonesia, Philippines, Vietnam, China, Hong Kong, Taiwan, Central Asia & Russia East of Urals.
  • Japan / Korea: Japan (TYO/OSA), South Korea (SEL), North Korea (FNJ).
  • South West Pacific (SWP): Australia (SYD/MEL/CBR), New Zealand (AKL/WLG), Fiji, PNG, Tahiti, Samoa, Guam.
